label: Gaucher disease
description: [MOCK] A lysosomal storage disease caused by deficient glucocerebrosidase (GCase) activity. Types 2 and 3 involve the nervous system (neuronopathic).

label: Gaucher disease type II
description: [MOCK] The acute neuronopathic form of Gaucher disease, with onset in infancy and rapid neurological decline.

label: Gaucher disease type III
description: [MOCK] The chronic neuronopathic form of Gaucher disease: enlarged spleen and liver, low platelets, and slowly progressive neurological signs such as abnormal eye movements and seizures.

label: GBA1-related Parkinson disease, susceptibility
description: [MOCK] Parkinson disease in people who carry a GBA1 variant. Carrying one variant raises the risk of Parkinson disease; it does not cause Gaucher disease.

label: Gaucher disease due to saposin C deficiency
synonyms: atypical Gaucher disease due to saposin C deficiency
description: [MOCK, PLACEHOLDER] Used as the honest-gap demo: a Gaucher-like disease with normal GCase, caused by PSAP variants. Coverage counts for it are placeholders until the snapshot exists.

label: GBA1
description: [MOCK] Encodes glucocerebrosidase (GCase), the lysosomal enzyme that breaks down glucosylceramide.

label: PSAP
description: [MOCK] Encodes prosaposin, which is cut into saposins A-D. Saposin C activates GCase.

label: Lysosomal dysfunction (glucosylceramide breakdown)
description: [MOCK] Cells cannot clear glucosylceramide inside the lysosome, so lipids build up and lysosomes work poorly.

label: Oculomotor apraxia
synonyms: difficulty moving the eyes on purpose

label: National Gaucher Foundation
description: [MOCK] US patient organization for people with Gaucher disease.

label: Cure Parkinson's
description: [MOCK] UK charity funding research to slow, stop or reverse Parkinson's. A funder of the ASPro-PD trial.

label: ASPro-PD: Ambroxol to Slow Progression in Parkinson Disease
synonyms: Ambroxol to Slow Progression in Parkinson Disease
description: Phase IIIa multi-centre randomised placebo-controlled trial (University College London). Enrols people with Parkinson's with and without GBA1 variants.

label: Ambroxol chaperone therapy for neuronopathic Gaucher disease: a pilot study (Narita et al., 2016)
description: Open-label pilot in five patients with neuronopathic Gaucher disease. Ann Clin Transl Neurol 2016;3(3):200-15.

label: Ambroxol (candidate pharmacological chaperone)
description: [MOCK] An old cough medicine studied as a chaperone that may raise GCase activity. Not an approved therapy for either disease.
